caption: The video showcases a horizontal multi-segment popsicle resting on a plain white plate, its speckled olive-green rounded tip at the left and a flat wooden stick protruding to the right. From left to right the body reads as a red band, a bright yellow band, and a pale cream-yellow band. A thin glossy line of meltwater tracks along the bottom edge of the body, most pronounced beneath the yellow and cream segments. This sheen gradually widens, and a small clear puddle spreads on the plate under the pale-yellow portion. The meltwater line becomes more continuous and reflective along the lower edge. The popsicle itself remains broadly in the same position and orientation, with no obvious translation or rotation of the left tip or the stick end. The change across the footage appears mainly from melting rather than movement.
relations: Heat melts the lower surface, causing the glossy meltwater line along the bottom edge to gradually widen.
Liquid accumulates beneath the pale-yellow segment, spreading a small clear puddle across the white plate surface.
The meltwater track becomes more continuous and reflective along the lower edge as dripping and pooling progress.
The popsicle body and protruding stick remain fixed in position and orientation throughout the melting process.
